card.name: Experience and knowing verbs in general prose
card.fires_on: Words about personal experience or awareness, such as experience, knows, understand, concerned, and own, in general web prose. It also fires on a few mid-word spots like cond-one and design-ates.

modes.description: The word experience or a verb of knowing or understanding, often after own or childhood.
